name: ivpn
title: IVPN Toggle
description: Toggle the IVPN connection from Raycast.
author: boradatti

preferences.name: preferredProtocol
preferences.title: Preferred Protocol
preferences.description: The VPN protocol this extension will use by default.

preferences.name: defaultConnectStrategy
preferences.title: Default Connect Strategy
preferences.description: How to choose an IVPN server when connecting.

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Connect
commands.description: Connects to IVPN when disconnected and disconnects when connected.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
